stages.name: refine
evidence: Reviewed #230, Epic #224, the accepted #228 read-only proof contract and plan, the merged #229 OAuth/OIDC boundary, current MCP composition, and the existing Family/Calendar query handlers.

Confirmed the release scope is limited to authorized read-only agenda and household-member workflows over the protected MCP endpoint; no write tools, persistence access, or unsupported client guarantees are included.

Confirmed pending tasks remain deferred because no complete Tasks-owned read query exists, and member-specific agenda remains excluded until the existing member/family authorization gap is resolved and tested.

All applicable Definition of Ready dimensions are present in the issue: actor, dependencies, acceptance criteria, scope/exclusions, product rules, affected behavior, quality/security expectations, existing decisions, and risks. Issue transitioned from status:backlog to status:ready.
